Other differing fields (warrant_uuid, started/completed_at, receipt/contract digests, tree ids) are fixed-width."}

{"item":"i-6be0","target":"t-ade4/i-6be0","on":"2026-09-26","note":"bundle.rs carried_receipt(): the receipt a bundle carries omits working_directory (host path, not tree content); the receipt file and its receipt_digest keep it. So a bundle's bytes, digest (the bundle-<digest16>.json name war verify writes/answers) and estimate are functions of the tree + config (+ the --performer argument). Unit test a_carried_receipt_does_not_depend_on_where_the_checkout_sits. 87-eval's determinism check now runs the second eval under a longer TMPDIR, so a path leak fails every time (old binary: 2750 vs 2756/2760/2754/2753 in 4/4 pairs)."}

{"item":"i-a00b","target":"t-ade4/i-a00b","on":"2026-09-26","note":"New binary: 30/30 pairs of full war eval run identical (second run under a TMPDIR 1-40 bytes longer, random), system load ~6-7; 30/30 again with 16 extra busy loops (load 19 on 20 cores). 87-eval plant passed 4 more times (with 84-bundle-budget, 47-bundle-output, 84-verify-bundle once)."}
